To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the valence quark density in the nucleon is well reproduced in a covariant scalar-diquark spectator model, (b) the nucleon electromagnetic form factors are also well reproduced by the same model, (c) the nucleon structure functions are well reproduced by this model, (d) the nucleon form factors are well reproduced by the spectator model, (e) the nucleon magnetic moments are well reproduced by a covariant scalar spectator model.

the valence quark distributions of the nucleon in a covariant scalar spectator model of the target are in good agreement with experimental data and the model is capable of describing the structure functions in a wide kinematic region.

the covariant scalar di-quark spectator model of nucleon structure is capable of describing the nucleon's electromagnetic form factor in a satisfactory manner and the nucleon's deep-inelastic structure functions with a reasonable level of accuracy, if the di-quark's mass and the di-quark-quark interaction strength are chosen appropriately.
